summary: Carrier Global filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of senior unsecured notes in two tranches, 2029 Notes and 2033 Notes, with principal amounts, coupons, and maturities left blank pending pricing. Net proceeds are earmarked to refinance existing debt, including repayment at maturity of the 2.493% Notes due 2027, with remainder for general corporate and working capital purposes, potentially commercial paper repayment. Notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, rank pari passu with existing senior debt, and carry a 101% change-of-control put. Joint book-running managers include Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Goldman Sachs, Barclays, Citigroup, HSBC, and Wells Fargo Securities. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch final coupon, size, and spread to Treasuries for funding cost signals.
